fusions.name: Toyed-With Prey
fusions.desc: A weapon strike usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health: it deals 25 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 30% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Nine-Tailed Scourge
fusions.desc: Lashes 9 chain tails in a fan out to 4 tiles, each dealing 1 damage with a 15% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Padded Tread
fusions.desc: Muffles your chains and veils you for 7 seconds: enemies notice you 70% later. Attacking breaks the veil.

fusions.name: Caught on the Tether
fusions.desc: Once every 120 seconds, a blow that would kill you is refused and leaves you at 1 health.
